verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show any capability for testing proposed detection rules against historical or sandbox events before activation, such as backtesting, rule simulation, or draft-workflow replay. Alloy's Sandbox is documented only as a per-request mode that skips vendor calls so customers can test their integration over shared production data. That is integration dry-run testing with no isolated environment and no rule-validation feature, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Scheduled and real-time transaction monitoring workflows exist, but nothing describes evaluating unactivated rules against past events.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can test proposed detection rules against historical or sandbox events before activation
